communities.inventoryNote: The current official community page and builder-syndicated portal expose three Oconee address cards. A separately indexed official available-homes result still shows 6120 and 6122 Wayburn, but the live community page no longer lists them; 6118 also disappeared. Their status is unresolved—no sale, cancellation or absorption is inferred. Portal headlines and cached cards are not released-home counts.
communities.thesis: The current three-home official roll cannot support the original ten October net-contract objective by itself. Conditional tests are $399,990 for 100 Epperly, $419,990 for 102 Epperly and $429,990 for end-unit 106 Epperly, subject to options, margin and release capacity; pair price with verified financing terms.
recommendations: For the documented entry home, test 100 Epperly at $399,990 after margin review: $20,000 below today’s ask and aligned with the six-sale gross median rounded to $399,990.

Test 102 Epperly at $419,990 and 106 Epperly at $429,990, subject to matched option and position review. This compresses the current $39,000-$44,000 premiums over the entry ask without assuming the homes are identical.

The three documented tests total $1,249,970, $416,657 average: $92,000 / 6.9% below the $1,342,970 current official ask total. This is a conditional merchandising test, not achieved ASP or an instruction to change listings.
Do not build a ten-contract plan from three visible cards. Reconcile 6118/6120/6122 and obtain a verified release list of at least ten contractable homes before setting a unit-by-unit ladder.

If all ten October net contracts remain as of October 16, the remaining 16 calendar days imply 4.38 net contracts per week. At illustrative 10% cancellation and 15% qualified-visit conversion, 12 gross contracts and 80 qualified visits would be required; these are sensitivities, not forecasts.

methodology: Public asking prices are not accepted contract prices. Closings shown are gross recorded prices; actual concessions and net proceeds are unknown.
Address samples and builder headline counts are not absorption. No sales pace, cancellations or incentives are inferred from card counts.
County statistics cover all residential property types. Active / monthly closings is a calculated ratio, not published months of supply or community absorption.
Price tests are analyst recommendations conditional on options, position, margin, released inventory and measured buyer response. They do not guarantee ten sales.

Research attempted October 16, 2026. Source registers distinguish successful current fields, older underlying updates, portal badges and failed rechecks. Carried records are not silently relabeled current.
